description.value: A quiet, well-spaced forest campground beside the Moyie River, straddling Highway 3/95 as a convenient rest stop near the small community of Yahk; the river runs fast and high in spring, and the gate closes in the off-season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The BC Parks website confirms Yahk Park is a 26-site campground along Highway 3/95 near the Moyie River, matching OSM. The website explicitly mentions cycling is permitted on roadways and that the adjacent town of Yahk has services. Reservations are confirmed via the 'Book camping' link and the frontcountry camping reservation page. The website notes e-bikes are restricted to park roads and not allowed on trails. OSM tags for water_point and toilets could not be confirmed from website text, so those amenities are marked null. The OSM phone belongs to the operator (EK Parks Ltd.), which is not shown in the fetched website content, so phone confirmation is null.
concerns: E-bikes are restricted to park roads only and not allowed on trails within the park

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A provincial park campground directly on Highway 3 (Crowsnest), a major east-west cycling route in southern BC, with nearby town services — a clear fit for touring cyclists.
